scope: Three pre-registered volatile official documentation URLs for embedding migration, ANN recall evaluation and hybrid-query filtering; no source discovery was performed.

verified_claims: Qdrant documents blue-green embedding migration with two parallel collections, dual writes during re-embedding, traffic cutover and dual-write disablement.
The guide states that named vectors can provide a single-collection alternative on supported versions, while blue-green migration works across collection types.
It explicitly warns that duplicated payloads add resource cost and that deletes or partial updates need pausing or additional migration logic.
records.boundary: This is a Qdrant migration procedure, not a universal zero-downtime guarantee. Cutover validation, update ordering, rollback and resource capacity require deployment-specific tests.

verified_claims: Qdrant defines ANN recall as how closely approximate nearest-neighbor search matches exact kNN, measured with recall@k.
The tutorial separates ANN-index recall from retrieval relevance, end-to-end pipeline output quality and business impact as different evaluation layers.
It presents exact search as a reference for evaluating approximate search rather than as a production replacement in every workload.
records.boundary: The evaluation layering is Qdrant guidance. Dataset, query set, k, distance metric, index settings and hardware determine measured recall and latency; ANN recall alone does not establish answer quality.

verified_claims: Azure AI Search documents preFilter as the default vector-filter mode in hybrid queries and describes postFilter and strictPostFilter as alternatives, with strictPostFilter marked Preview.
The guide states that post-filtering can return fewer results than top-n and explains that filters can be applied before query execution or after retrieval to trim results.
It warns that a targeted vector-subquery filter can override a global filter, including security-trimming filters, so filter scope must be reviewed explicitly.
records.boundary: These are Azure AI Search API semantics, including Preview behavior. Filter mode, candidate budget, security trimming and tail latency require workload-specific authorization and recall regression tests.
